examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The console Application page in a `ConsolePanel` `#scene` slot: each tab plays its page, then opens the create drawer (list tabs) or raises the save bar (form tabs).

examples.name: Band
examples.summary: One scene per tab in the `MediaTabs` `#media` slot at a narrower design `width`; `active` replays the second move when its tab comes back.
